messages:
Alex W: hey team — quick heads up, flight delay. I need to hand off primary tonight for inference-prod from ~21:45 UTC -> 02:00 UTC. I can stay online for the next ~20m but then I'm offline for the window. paging history: we had a small spike earlier but it settled. Can someone pick up primary or do a split handoff?

oncall-bot: @channel Reminder: primary shift for inference-prod currently assigned to Alex W until 02:00 UTC. To reassign use `/oncall transfer` or confirm in thread.

Jamie L: I can take primary from 21:50 until 23:45 UTC. I have a customer call at 23:15 but can be primary and then hand off to someone else at 23:45. Happy to shadow with Alex for the next 15m. :wave:

Riley S: I can cover 23:45 -> 02:00. I'll be remote and available on phone. I'll also shadow with Jamie for the first 10m post-handoff. Confirming I know the quick triage steps for inference-prod.

Taylor M: I'll be secondary for the block. Quick note for everyone: if you see error-rate >3% or 5xx spike, escalate to SEV2 and run the scaling step (see runbook). Otherwise quick mitigation is prefix cache flush + bump pool size.

Alex W: awesome — tagging infra in case we need fast capacity changes: @infra-team please standby for manual scale to dedicated-gpu-pool-2 if latency >200ms after 22:30 UTC. I'll update when airborne. :airplane:

Jamie L: confirmed primary 21:50-23:45. Riley will take 23:45-02:00. Taylor is secondary. I'll do an overlap shadow until 23:45 so coverage gap should be zero but note: Riley is in a different TZ and might have 1-2 minute delay on sms.

pagerduty-bot: Incident FYI: inference-prod high-latency alert triggered 21:02 UTC (resolved 21:12 UTC). Affected requests ~7% on /v1/generate. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-prod

Riley S: thanks — quick copy of the runbook snippets I keep handy:

```
# quick triage
curl -sS https://metrics.internal/api/series?query=rate(requests{service="inference-prod"}[5m]) | jq .
# check health
curl -I https://inference-prod.internal/healthz
# tail logs (k8s)
kubectl -n inference-prod logs -l app=inference-runtime -c runtime -f --tail=200
```

Also: if latency >200ms for >10m, open SEV2 and run the scale command below (uses infra credentials):

```
# scale GPU pool (console preferred)
# terraformer/infra quick command (ops-only)
infractl scale-gpu-pool --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-2 --replicas 6
```

Taylor M: adding two small runbook tips — 1) prefix cache flush clears KV cache for recent prompts: `/api/admin/cache/flush?prefix=kv:` and 2) when promoting fallback model, check outputs for hallucination regressions using the eval set in the console. If you do a fallback promote, set traffic split 90/10 for 15m first.

Jamie L: noted. One more operational note: watch token usage on the route `generate-stream` — bursts can eat through reserved capacity quickly. Console path: Console -> Routing -> inference-prod -> routes -> generate-stream.

Alex W: thanks all. Official handoff recorded here — primary: Jamie L (21:50-23:45), primary handback: Riley S (23:45-02:00), secondary: Taylor M. Shadowing: Alex W until 21:50 then Jamie until 23:45. No uncovered gap expected. I'll post when landed.

Riley S: I'll take over at 23:45 and will ping here on any escalations. If I'm slow to respond, call me at +1-555-987-6543.

Jamie L: quick sanity check: if a pager hits during my 23:00 standup, Riley will immediately have the pager — Riley, can you ack within 2 mins?

Riley S: yes can ack within 2 mins. If I can't, Taylor please escalate to infra pager.

Taylor M: yep i'll take infra pager if Riley can't. Good luck, everyone.

oncall-bot: Handoff logged: primary: Jamie L (21:50-23:45), primary: Riley S (23:45-02:00), secondary: Taylor M. Link to roster: https://redwood.internal/oncall/roster

Alex W: thanks team — really appreciate the cover. Posting final note when I land. :thumbsup:
